title: Chapter 424
paragraphs: Chapter 424
Episode 123: Suddenly Like This? (2)
"They came with armed mercenaries to the Sword Garden?"
"Yes. There were over five hundred mercenaries, roughly counted."
"Five hundred mercenaries... that's quite gutsy. Almost seems insane. When did they arrive?"
"About three hours ago."
"I suppose the mercenaries couldn't enter."
Indeed, only Rata Prochi had entered the Sword Garden.
Rata and the Ghost Brigade had been staying at the Sword Emperor's Castle, just like Jin. In other words, Rata had visited the Sword Garden as soon as he left the castle.
Naturally, since they arrived without any prior notice, leading a large force, Lun Kandel could not accept them.
'At least the Ghost Brigade avoided a disaster.'
If a shabby mercenary group of that size had made an unannounced visit, Lun Kandel would have killed them all and still had leftovers.

The Ghost Brigade belonged to one of the largest neutral forces, and their base, Gwigoksaeseong, was used as a conference hall for large forces, so they were safe despite committing such a breach of etiquette.
"That's correct."
"It's obvious that the guy with the evil-looking eyes came to see you because of my sister, but why did he bring five hundred followers? What, is it some cute threat?"
"I don't know why he brought the followers either. We'll find out when we go."
As the party began to move, the cheers grew louder.
Especially a group of boys and girls shouting Murakan's name were the most noticeable, and Gilly discreetly pushed Murakan's back so they wouldn't be disappointed.
"They're young friends, please wave your hand once, Murakan."
"Strawberry Pie, if you wish..."
Soon after, Jin and Gilly were extremely shocked when Murakan smiled at them and several boys and girls in the group suddenly fainted.
"My goodness, I thought only Enya was like that."
"I don't think Enya has ever fainted either."
They exited the teleportation gate and boarded the steel carriage.
The red evening glow enveloped the entire city warmly, but Jin shook his head nervously, sensing that somehow, something tiring was about to happen.
While they were heading well toward the Sword Garden, Jin stopped the carriage.
"Wait a moment."
It was because he had spotted Rata's followers standing idly at the crossroads leading to the entrance of the Sword Garden.
Even though there were as many as five hundred of them, they simply stood in the grass. It was impossible for them to set up tents in Lun Kandel's territory, especially near the Sword Garden.
But they couldn't just sit or lie down comfortably, and there was no inn to accommodate the suddenly-arrived five hundred mercenaries.
Therefore, Lata's subordinates had no choice but to stand still as if they themselves had become trees.
As Jin stuck his head out of the carriage, the mercenaries' gazes all gathered on him.
"Follow me."
Jin only said that before starting the carriage again, and Lata's subordinates exchanged glances and quietly followed behind.
"12th generation is entering!"
The gate was opened, and the patrolling guardians saluted.
'Last time I returned, the executioners had their swords drawn.'
That day was the day of the declaration of the family head. Even if it wasn't that day, Jin could hardly remember any warm welcome when he returned home since his days as a trainee.
It would be fair to say that there were none, except for the greetings from people like Gilly or Petro.
Be it siblings or elders. There was always someone who showed hostility and murderous intent, and they were all (externally) not easy opponents.
But today was different.
Guardian Knights 1st and 10th, a very small number of executioners and elders.
It was a force equivalent to slightly less than 10% of the total power of Runecandel, but now there were warriors to welcome Jin back.
"Sir, you've gone through a lot. 12th generation!"
"Have you arrived, 12th generation? The Garden of Swords has been noisy because of your absence."
As the knights and elders they encountered greeted them first, Jin suddenly felt that he had become the generation of Runecandel.
However, those who greeted him were also curious about why he brought the mercenaries who were waiting outside.
And far away, there were people walking towards Jin with their faces crumpled from the main building.
It was Mew and Ann.
"12th generation."
"What the hell are you doing right now?"
Seeing them picking a fight with such a fierce expression, Jin found it somewhat admirable.
Should he call them stupid?
Or should he say they were fearless?
One thing was for sure, they had perseverance that even Jin had to acknowledge.
Even though the gap in power was shown to be so great during the declaration of the family head, they still picked fights without hesitation.
Moreover, even though they were sure that they could "never" beat Jin even if they both attacked together at that time, their attitude didn't change.
"What are you thinking, bringing those rabble into the house?"

"Ha, it's because of your behavior that even these worthless people have started to look down on the Garden of Swords lately. Didn't the beasts of Kinzel come to find you unannounced last time? This is not a good look for the family. We can't kick them out right away!"
Jin looked at his sisters for a while without answering, then suddenly burst out laughing.
"Laughing?"
"I almost felt disappointed, sisters. I need someone to scold me like this to feel like I'm home."
"What, what did you say?"
"This bastard...!"
"They are my guests. They were unable to inform me of their visit in advance due to the constant state of emergency after the terrorist attack on Sword Emperor Castle, just like me."
"What kind of guest requests admission without notice, bringing over five hundred mercenaries?"

"What's the problem with that? Even if five hundred ghost troops came to the Sword Garden, it would only be a threat at the level of five hundred fallen leaves. Rather, Rata brought as many practitioners as possible to show courtesy to me."
Contrary to his angry sisters, Jin had a bright, smiling face.
At that strange mental game, no, it couldn't even be called a fight... Jin was overwhelmingly dominating his sisters, and the mercenaries who followed him were breathless.
'It's clear that the 12th Master is crazier than our captain. Is it okay to treat higher masters like that?'
'We're just waiting outside, and we'll go back quietly when the captain comes, so it doesn't feel too bad.'
'Our Gwigoksaeseong is quite amazing, but this place doesn't even compare. It's like bean flour.'
'But I think we're being a little ignored. No matter what, calling us fallen leaves...'
None of the mercenaries cried out in discomfort at Jin's fallen leaves remarks.
Rather, it was the sight of Mu and Anne continuing their boiling voices.

"Five hundred fallen leaves! You've reached some level of enlightenment and there's no end to the terrible things you say. If, as you say, the ghost troop leader showed you courtesy, you're just making dismissive remarks about them."
"Compared to leaving them standing outside, such words don't seem to be too disrespectful."
As Anne stepped forward toward Jin, Mu blocked her.
'This isn't going well. They're laughably cute now. Anne trying to step forward, Mu stopping her. It's as if they've planned this behavior pattern in advance.'
Then Mu, grinding her teeth with Anne, said this.
"Can you take responsibility?"
"What are you talking about?"
"I mean, can you take responsibility if any problems arise because of the guests you brought?"
"You talk as if there will definitely be problems. Well, let's do that. I'll take responsibility."
With a snap!
As Mu and Anne turned around and walked away, Gilly stroked her chest.
She didn't do it because she was worried about Jin.
"Phew, I don't know how nervous I was that Young Master would cut down the ladies."
"They're sisters with a lot of issues, but it's not time to get rid of them yet."
"I don't know why only those two are like this when your other sisters are not so rude. Kid, I have to play and eat with Strawberry Pie now, so you can meet the eyeball guy alone."
Murakan gave Gilly a sparkling look, but Gilly coughed and avoided her gaze.
"No, Murakan. You have something to do."
"What?"
"Guide the ghost troop friends and take them to my personal training ground."
"Ha! Hey, kid. I'm a great Black Dragon. Didn't you see all those people praising me earlier? Can you give me such a trivial task? Huh?"
"And protect them."
"What? Suddenly, protection?"

"Very likely, the Ghost Legion mercenaries will be attacked. Do you think my sisters left their seats just to talk about responsibility? From their point of view, it's a golden opportunity to give me a hard time."
"What... No way. Are they really going to do that?"

"They can't not do it. It doesn't hurt to be careful. Want to make a bet? I'll bet that my sisters' subordinates will attack the mercenaries. That way, there won't be any damage when I said I'd take responsibility, right?"

The reason he insisted on taking the mercenaries to the training ground, rather than a guest room or a reception room, was exactly that. It was much easier to protect them if they were all gathered in a spacious training ground.
Murakan narrowed his brows.

"Damn, I accept. I bet on the opposite side. If I win, you'll give me an absolute 15-day vacation with Strawberry Pie after the Ghost Legion leaves. Even if I don't want to go, you'll have to force me on vacation. Got it?"
"I don't really need a vacation..."
"Alright."
"Kid, what's your condition?"
"I don't have one. I'm going to win anyway. Instead, make sure the mercenaries don't get hurt."
"Don't complain later. Hehe, let's go! You mercenaries!"
Murakan hummed as he led the mercenaries to the training ground. He was already excited about spending 15 happy days with Gilly.
Jin couldn't help but laugh at his retreating figure, and Gilly gave an awkward smile.
"The lord regent said that you can skip the report."
Petro said.
Rosa was still recovering from the injury she received during the lord's declaration.
"Then I can meet Lata right away. He's in the reception room, right?"
"Yes, my lord. Would you like me to prepare another room?"
"No, I'll just go meet him directly."
The spacious reception room was filled with guests. Merchants, nobles, and mercenaries on missions who were trading with Run Candel.
Among them, the most prominent was Lata, who was leaning against the wall with his arms folded and emitting a heavy and sharp aura. No one was standing within about ten steps of him.
"Lata."
As Jin entered the reception room and called his name, Lata slowly opened his eyes.
With a very fast, and possibly threatening, stride, Lata approached Jin...
Shing!
As soon as he came a step in front of Jin, he suddenly drew a dagger from his bosom, causing the surrounding people and the waiting knights to panic.
"Stop...!"
The knights threw themselves at Lata as he seemed to be drawing a trajectory toward Jin with his dagger.
Squeak-!
However, Lata's dagger did not touch Jin's body.
With a dull sound, what fell to the floor was Lata's right index finger.
